# dsh-lsp-pyright > Python/Python stub 的 Pyright LSP 配置包，委托 DSH 共享基座启动外部 pyright-langserver。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs) - **版本号**：0.1.0（[固定提交 258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/tree/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce)） - **版本日期**：2026-09-01（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定源码支持双扩展映射及缺服 fallback；实际 Pyright/虚拟环境表现未测，catch-all 可能误报。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：在 DSH Agent 中查询 Python .py 与 .pyi 的定义、引用、实现和悬浮信息。 - **亮点**：减少 Python/Pyright LSP 命令与扩展配置工作；详见[Q01](#research-q01)。 - **思考**：缺服 fallback 捕获所有初始化异常且仅保留默认映射，配置故障可误归因，自定义扩展在故障时失去路由。详见[Q02](#research-q02)。 - **建议**：保留解析后的扩展表并区分缺服/配置/注册异常，可提高诊断准确度；待验证。详见[Q02](#research-q02)。 采用建议：先确认 pyright-langserver 在 DSH 执行环境 PATH，使用实际 .py/.pyi 与 venv 项目测试；详见[Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 核心贡献 减少 Python/Pyright LSP 命令与扩展配置工作；详见[Q01](#research-q01)。 ## 关键质疑 缺服 fallback 捕获所有初始化异常且仅保留默认映射，配置故障可误归因，自定义扩展在故障时失去路由。详见[Q02](#research-q02)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 保留解析后的扩展表并区分缺服/配置/注册异常，可提高诊断准确度；待验证。详见[Q02](#research-q02)。 隔离测试无服务器/错误配置/自定义扩展 fallback，以及真实虚拟环境项目导航。 ## 场景与替代办法 在 DSH Agent 中查询 Python .py 与 .pyi 的定义、引用、实现和悬浮信息。 手工在共享 DSH LSP 配置表加入 Pyright 与双扩展路由。 ## 依赖与流程 #### 启动与依赖 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | DSH LSP service/tool 与 fs/subprocess | 必需 | 模型查询及服务器托管 | 薄包独立不可用 | | pyright-langserver | Python 查询必需 | 语言分析 | 缺服时 LSP_UNAVAILABLE | | Python venv/配置 | 项目精度相关 | 解释器/依赖解析 | 结果精度待核 | #### 启动步骤 | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 安装 | 命令可执行 | PATH 可见 | | 项目 | .py/.pyi 与 venv | 映射正确 | | 查询 | 四项操作 | 结果可用 | ## 成本与效果 #### 成本 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次使用 | 另装 Pyright、共享 LSP 基座；许可证/现金未知 | 确保 pyright-langserver 在 PATH、配置 Python 环境与双扩展路由；耗时未知 | npm/pip/pipx 安装形态待环境核 | | 持续使用 | 每工作区 Pyright 索引/进程资源；量值未知 | 维护 venv/type 配置、核 .pyi 与跨文件结果；工时未知 | 真实项目准确度与资源未知 | | 失败恢复 | 重启/重索引及诊断可能追加资源；现金未知 | 区分缺服、配置错误和自定义扩展路由消失；耗时未知 | 真实 lane 无 server 时跳过 | #### 效果 | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 双扩展路由 | .py/.pyi | 跨文件正确性 | | 结构化降级 | LSP_UNAVAILABLE | 配置错误分类 | | 四项导航 | 基座提供 | 真实表现 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标：**核实 Pyright 包的双扩展路由、语言服务器前提及 fallback 的配置保真度。 ### Q01 · Python 导航和类型分析从哪里来？ **研究主题：**场景与需求、贡献与相对优势、功能与机制 #### 完整回答 该子包把 .py 与 .pyi 都映射到 python language id，默认以 pyright-langserver --stdio 启动外部服务器。它只将配置交给 DSH LspStdio 注册 provider，LSP 协议及面向模型的四项 lsp 查询由共享基座提供；“静态类型检查”来自 Pyright 服务器，不是包内算法。包不自动下载 server，用户可用 npm、pip 或 pipx 安装并确保命令在 PATH。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[dsh-lsp-pyright/README.md:3-25](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-pyright/README.md#L3-L25) 作者说明配置包与外部 Pyright 安装。
查看原文（23行） ````text > Pyright language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Static type checking and code intelligence for Python files. > 中文：DSH 的 Pyright LSP「即插即用」语言包 —— 装上本包，.py / .pyi 文件即可用 `lsp` 工具做代码导航。 This pack is one Cordis configuration plugin: it registers a configured `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio` instance on `ctx.lsp` with the server command, launch arguments, and extension mapping for Pyright. It implements **no LSP protocol** — the shared base does: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp` (the seam) + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-lsp` (the model-facing `lsp` tool with `goToDefinition` / `findReferences` / `goToImplementation` / `hover`). Twelve packs reuse one unchanged base. ## Installing the language server (three ways) ```bash npm install -g pyright # npm pip install pyright # pip pipx install pyright # pipx (isolated) ``` After install, `pyright-langserver` must be on `PATH` (npm/pipx put it there automatically). > ⚠️ The plugin itself **never downloads or installs the server binary** — matching the > upstream anthropics LSP plugins, the server is an external prerequisite. The plugin only > resolves and launches it. ````
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[dsh-lsp-pyright/src/index.ts:28-47](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-pyright/src/index.ts#L28-L47) 默认命令、provider 和双扩展表。
查看原文（20行） ```text /** Cordis plugin name for loader diagnostics. */ export const name = 'lsp-pyright' /** Services required by the shared LSP base this pack assembles. */ export const inject = ['fs', 'lsp', 'subprocess'] /** Stable provider id reserved on `ctx.lsp` by this pack. */ export const PROVIDER_ID = 'pyright' /** Default server command (absolute path or PATH-resolved executable, no shell). */ export const DEFAULT_COMMAND = 'pyright-langserver' /** Default launch arguments. */ export const DEFAULT_ARGS: readonly string[] = ["--stdio"] /** Default lowercase leading-dot extension → LSP language id table. */ export const DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE: Readonly> = { ".py": "python", ".pyi": "python" } ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[dsh-lsp-pyright/src/index.ts:153-161](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-pyright/src/index.ts#L153-L161) 委托 LspStdio apply。 ```text export async function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): Promise { const server = resolveServerConfig(config) try { // Resolve through lsp-stdio’s own Config schema so every documented default // (timer budgets, byte caps, env, ...) is filled before apply() — calling the // stdio apply directly bypasses the Cordis loader’s schema pass. const stdioConfig = LspStdio.Config({ servers: { [PROVIDER_ID]: server } }) await LspStdio.apply(ctx, stdioConfig) return ``` #### 缺口 - .py/.pyi及不同环境配置下四项导航和类型信息的实际适用范围缺少对照。 **影响：**不能从Pyright注册推断所有项目的导航或诊断能力。 **进一步探讨：**用含.py/.pyi与已知定义位置的项目区分导航结果和类型诊断。 ### Q02 · 缺少服务器和自定义扩展时会发生什么？ **研究主题：**工程质量与复用、缺陷与关键质疑 #### 完整回答 包的 fallback 设计使启动阶段无法解析服务器时 profile 仍可加载，受默认扩展匹配的查询返回 LSP_UNAVAILABLE。但 apply 用一个 catch 捕获 Config 和 apply 全部异常，配置错误与服务注册异常也可能被描述为服务器不可用；fallback 又只注册 DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE，虽然正常 resolveServerConfig 会合并用户自定义扩展，故故障时自定义扩展路由消失。README 对缺服情形的说明成立于特定错误，并不能涵盖所有 catch 路径。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[dsh-lsp-pyright/README.md:32-56](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-pyright/README.md#L32-L56) 作者描述 lazy start/fallback/覆盖。
查看原文（25行） ````text ## How the pack works - **Lazy start**: the server process is **not** started at load. `lsp-stdio` launches it lazily on the first matching query and keeps one process per workspace. - **No-server fallback**: if the executable cannot be resolved, the pack still loads; every `lsp` query for these extensions fails with a structured `LSP_UNAVAILABLE` error naming the command — the rest of the session is unaffected. - **Config overrides**: every default below can be overridden from the composition row, e.g. a server installed at a non-standard path: ```yaml - id: lsp-pyright name: '@dsh-lsp-packs/dsh-lsp-pyright' config: command: /absolute/path/to/pyright-langserver args: - --stdio extensionToLanguage: '.xyz': custom-language-id maxDocumentBytes: 8000000 ``` All fields of the `servers` table documented in the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio` README are accepted (`command`, `args`, `env`, `extensionToLanguage`, `initializationOptions`, `configuration`, byte/time bounds). ````
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[dsh-lsp-pyright/src/index.ts:103-118](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-pyright/src/index.ts#L103-L118) 配置覆盖合并。
查看原文（16行） ```text /** Merge the pack defaults with the user overrides into one stdio server entry. */ export function resolveServerConfig(config: Config): ResolvedServerConfig { const server: ResolvedServerConfig = { command: config.command ?? DEFAULT_COMMAND, args: config.args ?? [...DEFAULT_ARGS], extensionToLanguage: { ...DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE, ...(config.extensionToLanguage ?? {}) }, } if (config.env !== undefined) server.env = config.env if (config.initializationOptions !== undefined) server.initializationOptions = config.initializationOptions if (config.configuration !== undefined) server.configuration = config.configuration if (config.maxMessageBytes !== undefined) server.maxMessageBytes = config.maxMessageBytes if (config.maxStderrBytes !== undefined) server.maxStderrBytes = config.maxStderrBytes if (config.maxDocumentBytes !== undefined) server.maxDocumentBytes = config.maxDocumentBytes if (config.shutdownTimeoutMs !== undefined) server.shutdownTimeoutMs = config.shutdownTimeoutMs if (config.killGraceMs !== undefined) server.killGraceMs = config.killGraceMs return server ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[dsh-lsp-pyright/src/index.ts:121-169](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-pyright/src/index.ts#L121-L169) 宽捕获与默认映射 fallback。

> Pyright language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Static type checking and code intelligence for Python files.
> 中文：DSH 的 Pyright LSP「即插即用」语言包 —— 装上本包，.py / .pyi 文件即可用 `lsp` 工具做代码导航。

This pack is one Cordis configuration plugin: it registers a configured
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio` instance on `ctx.lsp` with the server command, launch
arguments, and extension mapping for Pyright. It implements **no LSP protocol** —
the shared base does: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp` (the seam) + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-lsp` (the
model-facing `lsp` tool with `goToDefinition` / `findReferences` / `goToImplementation` /
`hover`). Twelve packs reuse one unchanged base.

## Installing the language server (three ways)

```bash
npm install -g pyright        # npm
pip install pyright           # pip
pipx install pyright          # pipx (isolated)
```

After install, `pyright-langserver` must be on `PATH` (npm/pipx put it there automatically).

> ⚠️ The plugin itself **never downloads or installs the server binary** — matching the
> upstream anthropics LSP plugins, the server is an external prerequisite. The plugin only
> resolves and launches it.

## Supported extensions

| `.py` | `python` |
| `.pyi` | `python` |

## How the pack works

- **Lazy start**: the server process is **not** started at load. `lsp-stdio` launches it
  lazily on the first matching query and keeps one process per workspace.
- **No-server fallback**: if the executable cannot be resolved, the pack still loads;
  every `lsp` query for these extensions fails with a structured `LSP_UNAVAILABLE` error
  naming the command — the rest of the session is unaffected.
- **Config overrides**: every default below can be overridden from the composition row,
  e.g. a server installed at a non-standard path:

```yaml
- id: lsp-pyright
  name: '@dsh-lsp-packs/dsh-lsp-pyright'
  config:
    command: /absolute/path/to/pyright-langserver
    args:
      - --stdio
    extensionToLanguage:
      '.xyz': custom-language-id
    maxDocumentBytes: 8000000
```

 * dsh-lsp-pyright — Pyright language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness.
 *
 * One language pack = one npm package that registers a configured
 * `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio` instance on `ctx.lsp`. The pack ships the
 * server command, launch arguments, and the extension → language-id table
 * for its language; the deployment composes the shared LSP base once (the
 * `lsp` service, the `lsp` tool, and a filesystem/subprocess pair for the
 * same execution world) and every language pack reuses it unchanged.
 *
 * The server is NOT launched at load: `lsp-stdio` starts processes lazily on
 * the first matching query. When the server executable cannot be resolved,
 * the pack still loads and every query fails with a structured
 * `LSP_UNAVAILABLE` error naming the missing command, so the rest of the
 * session keeps working.
 *
 * Namespace plugin (named exports, no default export).
 * @module @dsh-lsp-packs/dsh-lsp-pyright
 */

import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
import z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'
import { LspError, LspProviderId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp'
import type { LspProvider, LspProviderQuery, LspQueryResult } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp'
import * as LspStdio from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio'
import type { LspLocalServerConfig } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio'

/** Cordis plugin name for loader diagnostics. */
export const name = 'lsp-pyright'

/** Services required by the shared LSP base this pack assembles. */
export const inject = ['fs', 'lsp', 'subprocess']

/** Stable provider id reserved on `ctx.lsp` by this pack. */
export const PROVIDER_ID = 'pyright'

/** Default server command (absolute path or PATH-resolved executable, no shell). */
export const DEFAULT_COMMAND = 'pyright-langserver'

/** Default launch arguments. */
export const DEFAULT_ARGS: readonly string[] = ["--stdio"]

/** Default lowercase leading-dot extension → LSP language id table. */
export const DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
    ".py": "python",
    ".pyi": "python"
}

/**
 * Pack configuration. Every field is optional and overrides the pack default;
 * leaving a field unset keeps the README-documented default. This is how a
 * user points the pack at a server installed at a non-standard path.
 */
export interface Config {
  /** Override the server command (absolute path or PATH name). */
  command?: string
  /** Override the launch arguments (replaces the default list entirely). */
  args?: string[]
  /** Extra environment variables merged on top of the scrubbed ambient env. */
  env?: Record<string, string>
  /** Extra extension → language-id entries merged on top of the defaults. */
  extensionToLanguage?: Record<string, string>
  /** Static `initialize` options forwarded to the server. */
  initializationOptions?: unknown
  /** Static answer to every `workspace/configuration` item. */
  configuration?: unknown
  /** Largest single framed message accepted from the server (bytes). */
  maxMessageBytes?: number
  /** Largest stderr tail retained for diagnostics (bytes). */
  maxStderrBytes?: number
  /** Largest source file this host will open (bytes). */
  maxDocumentBytes?: number
  /** Graceful shutdown/exit budget before escalation (ms). */
  shutdownTimeoutMs?: number
  /** Request-cancel and SIGTERM→SIGKILL grace (ms). */
  killGraceMs?: number
}

export const Config: z<Config> = z.object({
  command: z.string(),
  args: z.array(String),
  env: z.dict(String),
  extensionToLanguage: z.dict(String),
  initializationOptions: z.any(),
  configuration: z.any(),
  maxMessageBytes: z.number(),
  maxStderrBytes: z.number(),
  maxDocumentBytes: z.number(),
  shutdownTimeoutMs: z.number(),
  killGraceMs: z.number(),
})

/**
 * The server entry this pack always fills completely: `command`, `args`, and
 * `extensionToLanguage` are guaranteed present (defaults or user overrides).
 */
export type ResolvedServerConfig = LspLocalServerConfig & {
  command: string
  args: string[]
  extensionToLanguage: Record<string, string>
}

/** Merge the pack defaults with the user overrides into one stdio server entry. */
export function resolveServerConfig(config: Config): ResolvedServerConfig {
  const server: ResolvedServerConfig = {
    command: config.command ?? DEFAULT_COMMAND,
    args: config.args ?? [...DEFAULT_ARGS],
    extensionToLanguage: { ...DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE, ...(config.extensionToLanguage ?? {}) },
  }
  if (config.env !== undefined) server.env = config.env
  if (config.initializationOptions !== undefined) server.initializationOptions = config.initializationOptions
  if (config.configuration !== undefined) server.configuration = config.configuration
  if (config.maxMessageBytes !== undefined) server.maxMessageBytes = config.maxMessageBytes
  if (config.maxStderrBytes !== undefined) server.maxStderrBytes = config.maxStderrBytes
  if (config.maxDocumentBytes !== undefined) server.maxDocumentBytes = config.maxDocumentBytes
  if (config.shutdownTimeoutMs !== undefined) server.shutdownTimeoutMs = config.shutdownTimeoutMs
  if (config.killGraceMs !== undefined) server.killGraceMs = config.killGraceMs
  return server
}

/** A provider that keeps extension routing alive while the server is missing. */
class UnavailableProvider implements LspProvider {
  readonly id = LspProviderId(PROVIDER_ID)
  readonly extensionToLanguage: Readonly<Record<string, string>>

  constructor(extensions: Readonly<Record<string, string>>, private readonly reason: string) {
    this.extensionToLanguage = { ...extensions }
  }

  query(_request: LspProviderQuery): Promise<LspQueryResult> {
    const message =
      'language server for ' + PROVIDER_ID + ' is unavailable: ' + this.reason + '. '
      + 'Install the language server (see the pack README) and reload the profile or session.'
    return Promise.reject(new LspError(message, 'LSP_UNAVAILABLE'))
  }
}

/** Extract a stable message from an unknown load-time failure. */
function failureMessage(error: unknown): string {
  if (error instanceof Error) return error.message
  return String(error)
}

/**
 * Register the configured stdio provider for the language, or a structured
 * no-server fallback when the executable cannot be resolved at load.
 *
 * The pack never crashes the session: an unresolvable server only disables
 * this language routing and surfaces `LSP_UNAVAILABLE` on queries.
 * @param ctx - the plugin context (must inject `fs`, `lsp`, `subprocess`).
 * @param config - the resolved pack configuration.
 */
export async function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): Promise<void> {
  const server = resolveServerConfig(config)
  try {
    // Resolve through lsp-stdio’s own Config schema so every documented default
    // (timer budgets, byte caps, env, ...) is filled before apply() — calling the
    // stdio apply directly bypasses the Cordis loader’s schema pass.
    const stdioConfig = LspStdio.Config({ servers: { [PROVIDER_ID]: server } })
    await LspStdio.apply(ctx, stdioConfig)
    return
  } catch (error) {
    const reason = failureMessage(error)
    console.warn('[' + name + '] ' + DEFAULT_COMMAND + ' unavailable at load: ' + reason)
    ctx.effect(() => {
      const dispose = ctx.lsp.registerProvider(
        new UnavailableProvider(DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE, reason),
      )
      return () => dispose()
    }, name + '.unavailableFallback')
  }
}

 *  3. `real server` — the lsp tool’s four operations against a sample file;

import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { mkdtemp, mkdir, realpath, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'

import { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'

import type { LspQueryRequest, LspQueryResult } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp'

import LocalFileSystem from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local'
import * as Pack from '../src/index.ts'

/** Probe whether the language server binary truly runs. */
function probeServer(command: string): boolean {
  const probe = spawnSync(command, ['--version'], {
    encoding: 'utf8',
    timeout: 10_000,
    shell: process.platform === 'win32',
  })
  // Spawn failure or timeout (ENOENT / killed) never counts as installed.
  if (probe.error !== undefined || probe.status === null) return false
  if (probe.status === 0) return true
  // Some servers (e.g. sourcekit-lsp) reject `--version` with a usage error while
  // running fine; only output saying the binary itself is missing skips the lane
  // (this also skips a rustup shim whose component is not installed).
  const output = String(probe.stdout ?? '') + String(probe.stderr ?? '')
  return !/(no such file|not found|unknown binary|command not found|ENOENT)/i.test(output)
}

const installed = probeServer('pyright-langserver')

const prebuild = null

// Lane 1: pack defaults ------------------------------------------------
describe('dsh-lsp-pyright pack defaults', () => {
  it('declares the README-default command, args, provider id, and extension table', () => {
    expect(Pack.name).toBe('lsp-pyright')
    expect(Pack.PROVIDER_ID).toBe('pyright')
    expect(Pack.inject).toEqual(['fs', 'lsp', 'subprocess'])
    expect(Pack.DEFAULT_COMMAND).toBe('pyright-langserver')
    expect([...Pack.DEFAULT_ARGS]).toEqual(["--stdio"])
    expect({ ...Pack.DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE }).toEqual({".py":"python",".pyi":"python"})
  })

  it('keeps defaults when no override is given and merges user overrides on top', () => {
    const defaults = Pack.resolveServerConfig({})
    expect(defaults.command).toBe('pyright-langserver')
    expect([...defaults.args]).toEqual(["--stdio"])
    expect(defaults.extensionToLanguage).toEqual({".py":"python",".pyi":"python"})
    const overridden = Pack.resolveServerConfig({ command: '/custom/server', args: ['-x'] })
    expect(overridden.command).toBe('/custom/server')
    expect([...overridden.args]).toEqual(['-x'])
    expect(overridden.extensionToLanguage).toEqual({".py":"python",".pyi":"python"})
  })
})

// Lane 2: missing-server fallback (offline) ---------------------------
describe('dsh-lsp-pyright missing-server fallback', () => {
  let ctx: Context

  beforeAll(async () => {
    ctx = new Context()
    await ctx.plugin(Lsp)
    await ctx.plugin(LocalSubprocessRuntime)
    await ctx.plugin(LocalFileSystem, { cwd: process.cwd() })
    await ctx.plugin(Pack, { command: 'definitely-missing-pyright-server-xyz' })
  }, 20_000)

  afterAll(async () => {
    if (ctx) await ctx.fiber.dispose()
  })

  it('loads without throwing and fails queries with a structured LSP_UNAVAILABLE error', async () => {
    const request: LspQueryRequest = {
      operation: 'goToDefinition',
      filePath: 'sample.py',
      position: { line: 0, character: 0 },
      workspaceRoot: process.cwd(),
    }
    await expect(ctx.lsp.query(request)).rejects.toThrow(
      expect.objectContaining({ code: 'LSP_UNAVAILABLE' }),
    )
  })
})

// Lane 3: real server (auto-skip when not installed) ------------------
describe.skipIf(!installed)('dsh-lsp-pyright real server (pyright-langserver)', () => {
  let ctx: Context
  let ws: string
  let root: string

  beforeAll(async () => {
    root = await realpath(await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'dsh-lsp-pyright-')))
    ws = join(root, 'proj')
    await mkdir(ws)

    await writeFile(join(ws, 'sample.py'), [
      'def add(a: int, b: int) -> int:',
      '    """Add two numbers."""',
      '    return a + b',
      '',
      '',
      'result = add(1, 2)',
    ].join('\n'))


    ctx = new Context()
    await ctx.plugin(Lsp)
    await ctx.plugin(LocalSubprocessRuntime)
    await ctx.plugin(LocalFileSystem, { cwd: process.cwd() })
    await ctx.plugin(Pack)
  }, 60_000)

  afterAll(async () => {
    if (ctx) await ctx.fiber.dispose()
    if (root) await rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true })
  })

/** One-based helper mirroring the model contract; converted to zero-based positions here. */
  function at(operation: LspQueryRequest['operation'], line1: number, char1: number, filePath = 'sample.py'): LspQueryRequest {
    return { operation, filePath, position: { line: line1 - 1, character: char1 - 1 }, workspaceRoot: ws }
  }

  it('goToDefinition resolves the definition at a call site', async () => {

    // Line 6, col 10 is the symbol under test in sample.py.
    const result = await ctx.lsp.query(at('goToDefinition', 6, 10))
    expect(result.kind).toBe('locations')
    if (result.kind === 'locations') {
      expect(result.locations.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1)
    }
  }, 60_000)

  it('findReferences finds references to the symbol including its declaration', async () => {

    // Line 1, col 5 is the symbol under test in sample.py.
    const result = await ctx.lsp.query(at('findReferences', 1, 5))
    expect(result.kind).toBe('locations')
    if (result.kind === 'locations') {
      expect(result.locations.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1)
    }
  }, 60_000)

  it('goToImplementation resolves the implementation of the symbol', async () => {

    // Line 6, col 10 is the symbol under test in sample.py.
    const result = await ctx.lsp.query(at('goToImplementation', 6, 10))
    expect(result.kind).toBe('locations')
    if (result.kind === 'locations') {
      expect(result.locations.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1)
    }
  }, 60_000)

  it('returns hover information for a typed symbol', async () => {
    // Hover on the declaring `add` name (line 1, col 5).
    const result = await ctx.lsp.query(at('hover', 1, 5))
    expect(result.kind).toBe('hover')
    if (result.kind === 'hover') {
      expect(result.hover).not.toBeNull()
      if (result.hover !== null) expect(result.hover.contents).toContain('Add two numbers')
    }
  }, 60_000)
})
